learning_outcomes.text: Basic knowledge about the use and programming of computers, operating systems, databases, and computer programs with application in engineering.

syllabus_topics: TOPIC 1. INTRODUCTION TO COMPUTER SCIENCE: Computer architecture. Constitutive elements of the Central Processing Unit. Operating Systems.

TOPIC 2. INTRODUCTION TO PROGRAMMING: Program concept. Algorithm concept. Algorithm representation: Flowcharts and pseudocode. Coding levels. Programming languages. Interpreters and compilers. Data types and elementary operations. The MATLAB environment. Vector and matrix operations. Variable control.

TOPIC 3. PROGRAM FLOW CONTROL. STRUCTURED PROGRAMMING: Program flow control structures. Sequential structure. Branching or conditional structures. Repetitive structures or loops. Programs: Scripts and functions. Application of modular programming to the Matlab programming language.
TOPIC 4. ADVANCED DATA TYPES. INPUT/OUTPUT FUNCTIONS: Complex numbers, character strings, data cells, and data structures. File reading and writing.

TOPIC 5. GRAPHICAL TOOLS: Representation and formatting of xy graphs, multiple graphs, axes and representation scales, creation of graphic files, other types of graphs (histograms, 3D graphs...), graph control.
TOPIC 6. INTRODUCTION TO DATABASES: Data structures. Types of databases.
teaching_methods: Practical activities in laboratories, computer labs and field trips
Practices in laboratory, computer lab and field trips
assessment_rules: The final grade is the weighted average of the assessment activities, provided each activity meets its minimum score. To pass, the weighted average must be at least 5 out of 10. If one or more activities do not meet the minimum score, the final grade for the course will be the highest score among the activities that failed to reach the minimum. For the extraordinary retake, students only retake failed re-evaluable activities, and the final grade is calculated using grades from passed ordinary activities and retaken activities. A minimum score of 4 out of 10 is required for the Exam and Laboratory Practices. Mandatory attendance of 85% is required for laboratory practices.
